description: This file implements platform-specific file operations for FreeRTOS within the libwebsockets project. It includes functions for opening, closing, reading, writing, and seeking in files, as well as specific implementations for string search within files and file serialization using NVS for embedded systems.

methods.name: int lws_plat_apply_FD_CLOEXEC(int n)
methods.description: Stub implementation, returns 0 indicating no operation.

methods.name: lws_fop_fd_t IRAM_ATTR _lws_plat_file_open(const struct lws_plat_file_ops * fops,const char * filename,const char * vpath,lws_fop_flags_t * flags)
methods.description: Opens a file, retrieves its size, and returns a file descriptor structure.

methods.name: int IRAM_ATTR _lws_plat_file_close(lws_fop_fd_t * fops_fd)
methods.description: Closes a file descriptor and frees associated resources.

methods.name: lws_fileofs_t IRAM_ATTR _lws_plat_file_seek_cur(lws_fop_fd_t fops_fd,lws_fileofs_t offset)
methods.description: Seeks to a position relative to current position in file.

methods.name: int IRAM_ATTR _lws_plat_file_read(lws_fop_fd_t fops_fd,lws_filepos_t * amount,uint8_t * buf,lws_filepos_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from a file into buffer, updates position, and reports read amount.

methods.name: int IRAM_ATTR _lws_plat_file_write(lws_fop_fd_t fops_fd,lws_filepos_t * amount,uint8_t * buf,lws_filepos_t len)
methods.description: Writes data from buffer into file, updates position, and reports written amount.

methods.name: int lws_find_string_in_file(const char * filename,const char * string,int stringlen)
methods.description: Searches for a colon-separated string in a file stored in NVS, retrieves associated value.

methods.name: int lws_plat_write_file(const char * filename,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file identified by filename in NVS storage.

methods.name: int lws_plat_read_file(const char * filename,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads data from a file identified by filename in NVS storage into buffer.

methods.name: int lws_plat_write_cert(struct lws_vhost * vhost,int is_key,int fd,void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes certificate or key data to specified paths in the vhost structure.
